description: E1: the lead pays off. At the Moot the giant finds Harrok's banner on the road meant war: Orrik the Fetterer, Harrok's sister-son, grown at the Stones to a colossus, has staked the Skarn's fetter-winches round the ring and stands before the Stone Throne to take it. With Harrok slain in act one Orrik comes for the throne for the clan; with Harrok spared (or knelt to the talk ending) Orrik rejects his uncle's peace, and Harrok comes to stand beside the giant. Bring Orrik down; then settle the Moot - the clan's eldest at the oath-stone (Harrok slain: the clan kneels) or Harrok at his stone (he holds the Moot for the giant and gives his oath-ring). The last word carries a rumour from the east: a titan burning a road toward the kingdom (quest.cinder_lead).

stages.objective: Answer Orrik's challenge in the Moot's ring and bring him down
stages.waiting_text: Orrik waits before the Stone Throne with the Skarn's fetter-winches staked round the ring. Only a colossus of the eighth stage should step in - and tear every chain that bites.

stages.objective: Settle the Moot at the Stone Throne
